gaps.topic: Supermicro largest supplier identity (63.1% of FY2026 purchases) and largest customer (28.1% of FY2026 net sales)
gaps.why: Supermicro's FY2026 10-K discloses the concentrations but does not name the supplier or the customer, so no FinancialLink can be drawn to a named counterparty.
gaps.would_need: A Supermicro filing or counterparty filing naming the supplier/customer (e.g., an 8-K material contract).

gaps.topic: Supermicro non-cancelable purchase commitments of $34.2 billion (as of 2026-06-30)
gaps.why: Disclosed in the FY2026 10-K (MD&A, Note 15) without counterparties.

gaps.topic: Dell AI-server supply chain (GPU supplier, assembly sites)
gaps.why: Dell's FY2026 10-K lists owned manufacturing in the United States, Malaysia, China, Brazil, India, Poland and Ireland but does not name sites that build AI-optimized servers or name GPU suppliers; Dell purchase obligations are disclosed without counterparties.
gaps.would_need: Dell filing or official release naming AI-server integration sites and GPU supply agreements.
